I truly don’t have enough words to express my gratitude for Dr Masrani & Dr Theertha.

Dr Masrani has become my go-to doctor for absolutely everything. I trust him with my life.
My journey with him began about five years ago when I consulted him for hormonal issues that were affecting my skin. From the very first interaction, his calm, reassuring, and unhurried way of explaining things put me completely at ease.

Over the years, he has guided me through multiple challenges. I underwent fibroid surgery under his care, and the entire experience was incredibly smooth. I was able to resume normal activity from Day 2. What stood out most was how clearly he explained the procedure beforehand, and post-surgery, he took the time to explain what had been resolved and what hadn’t giving me complete clarity and confidence.

One of the most critical moments for me was during a vacation when I experienced severe stomach pain that went undiagnosed. I reached out to Dr. Masrani, and he immediately advised a scan, which revealed a ruptured appendix. By the time I returned to Mumbai, everything was arranged overnight at Masrani Hospital, and the surgery was successfully performed. That level of responsiveness and care is something I will never forget.

Later, when my husband and I were trying to conceive, Dr. Masrani and Dr. Theertha supported us every step of the way. When I finally got pregnant, my entire pregnancy journey was incredibly positive and reassuring because of them. They were always available, patiently addressing every doubt and fear.
At the age of 36, I had a normal delivery, and what made it even more special was how empowered and fearless I felt throughout labour. I delivered within 8 hours of being admitted. Before discharge, the doctors even sat with us to prepare us for parenthood, what to expect as new parents and how to care for both the baby and me. That kind of holistic care is rare.

The support staff at the hospital are also incredibly kind, especially Nurse Harshali, who offered many useful tips on managing labour pain, caring for the baby, and overall recovery.

It is difficult to fully articulate how much my life has changed for the better through this journey. A huge part of that credit goes to Dr. Masrani and Dr. Theertha. I will forever be grateful.
